about: BIOME RINGS (Dom 2026-10-28, 'no switches, just get everything live in game'): the zone's spawns are placed in rings by DISTANCE FROM THE DUEL PIT'S CENTRE (where the hero first stands; metres; src/zone/rings.ts). Ring 1 is the three bosses the zone row (data/zones/zone1.row.json) already places, byte for byte (Gargantua, Arachne, Minotaur; a test pins them): this file adds no spawn to it. Rings 2 and 3 take the nine merged-but-unwired bodies. Nothing here is a switch: it is on, and every number is a row, validated at load (src/zone/rings.ts validateRings) and again by test/rings.test.mjs. RING ROWS: `minDist`..`maxDist` the band a ring's spawns stand in (rings do not overlap; ring 1 covers the zone row's own three); `blendAtMetres` the distance at which the ring's LOOK is full (between two rings the look is mixed by distance, so the ground and the sky change gradually, never in a step); `groundTint` a #rrggbb that MULTIPLIES the sand's colour (data/stage.json ground.color; #ffffff = untouched, so ring 1 is today's floor); `skyPlates` a brightness weight 0..2 for each of the sky ring's plates east, south and west (data/stage.json skyline.ring.plates; the existing pictures only, no new art; north is the page's own plate and is not touched); `health` and `damage` the ring's difficulty multipliers, laid over every boss of the ring as a ?tune= multiplier (src/tune.ts; they multiply the profile and difficulty rows' scales, they do not replace them; 1 = none); `loadAfterKillMetres` how near the hero must come before a boss of this ring is FETCHED once a first kill has happened (null = respawn.json world.loadRadiusAfterKillMetres, ring 1's own rule; the near-load, world.loadWithinMetres, is unchanged for every ring), so a ring 2 or 3 body is never fetched on the first visit and not in the background after the first kill either, only when the hero walks up to it. `spawns`: which boss `kind`s stand in the ring, how many (`count`), and where: `angleDeg` clockwise from north (the -Z axis, dead ahead at the first heading) and `distance` metres from the pit's centre (inside minDist..maxDist), instance i of a count at angleDeg + i x stepDeg. Positions are rounded to 1/roundTo of a metre. BOSS ROWS (`bosses`): one per ring boss. `kind` is its data/profiles.json row id (a clone of Arachne's shieldmaiden or the Minotaur's pitborn at the same stats and health, 137 hp at the default pick; the profile row says which); `body` its data/rig.json files stem, drawn through the zone spawn's per-spawn `body`; `name` is the HUD name (a placeholder from the body's stem where Dom has not named it yet); `respawnSeconds`, `aggro`, `leash`, `roam`, `campSize` become the zone spawn's rows; `mechanic` is the ONE signature move the boss gets later, null today (not built). A body without a cut manifest or a data/physics.json opponents row (all nine) dies the plain ragdoll way, with no error (docs/BOSS-BODIES.md). Walk distance (Dom 2026-10-28, playing live: 'these bosses seem very very far away ... we need quite frequent combat, bring them a bit closer, not crazy close like last time'): ring 2 stands 68 m and ring 3 105 m from the pit (the two TUNING KNOBS: each ring's spawns `distance` and its `blendAtMetres`), at hero run speed 5.2 m/s (src/fight/world-rules-defs.json playerRun) that is 12.6 s and 19.7 s to the first boss of each ring. `spacing` is the layout contract (test/boss-spacing.test.mjs): `marginMetres` over two leashes plus an aggro is the nearest any ring 2 or ring 3 boss may stand to any other boss (the camps' fights never bleed into each other; #166 'bosses 33 m+ apart' was the earlier, tighter limit, and ring 1's own pair is still 33 m); `hopSeconds` [min, max] of running from one boss's spot to its nearest neighbour; `firstBossSeconds` [min, max] from the pit to the first boss of rings 2 and 3. Before this change the rings stood at 85 and 130 m, 90 degrees apart, 120 m or more from each other (23 s). Positions are rounded to 1/roundTo of a metre.

limits.about: Validation ranges for the rows above.
